Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly classified rusting as a physical change. Rusting is a classic example of a chemical change because it involves the oxidation of iron, creating a new substance (iron oxide) with different properties, whereas the other options (breaking glass, dissolving sugar, evaporating water) are physical changes where the chemical identity of the substance remains the same.
